0022600119.text: The Charlotte Hornets host the Washington Wizards in the fourth game of Charlotte's season, with the Hornets at 1-1 overall, 0-1 at home, and currently 8th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast, one game back, after a loss in their most recent game. Washington is also 1-1, sitting 5th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, one game back, with a 1-1 home record and a one-game losing streak. Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery), while Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Hornets won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 129-112 win in Washington on February 22, 2026.
